page.layout: One block of running text in a single column; a printed catchword-style signature "( 3" at the foot with the running word "bræum" to its right; a running head ornament at the top centre.

main_text.p: orum Religione institui posit sermo , quam si ex ipsis sapiamus, loquamurque Judeis; Accedit quoque, quod varios Gentis hujus à multis annis consuluimus Doctores, qui consensum suum unanimem sincera testati fuerunt fide: Quod si horum à nobis efflagitares testimonia, profecto rem nobis faceres gratissimam, Sic pariter textum Hebræum

page.notes: The running head ornament at the top is decorative and omitted. The catchword "bræum" is printed at the right foot; I have transcribed it as "braeum" in the catchword element, with the æ ligature kept as printed in the text line. Long s throughout is plain s.
